# Phase One — Chessed Without Ceiling

The Awtsmoos creates every finite vessel anew; Awtsmoos.com should therefore become one coherent universe where discovery, usefulness, commerce, trust, delight, speed, accessibility, and retention all reinforce each other.

## Boundless Product Vision
- Every public app and game is crawlable before JavaScript and understandable in seconds.
- Every canonical product has one source of truth for title, description, route, category, capabilities, paid value, related workflows, tests, screenshots, and lifecycle state.
- Every product opens beautifully at 360px, 390px, tablet, desktop, keyboard-only, reduced-motion, high-contrast, and RTL/Hebrew modes.
- Every product has graceful loading, empty, offline, failure, retry, recovery, and success states.
- Every paid action is server-priced, idempotent, reversible until value delivery, observable, reconcilable, and never dark-patterned.
- Every free product remains genuinely useful; paid value adds expensive compute, advanced automation, permanent cosmetics, premium content, collaboration, storage, or convenience.
- Every finished output suggests the next useful cross-product action.
- Every user can resume recent projects, favorite products, discover related tools, and see owned capabilities from one coherent shell.
- Search engines receive useful static inventory, canonical metadata, OpenGraph, JSON-LD, and sitemaps sourced from canonical product truth.
- Analytics measures acquisition, activation, conversion, paid outcome success, retention, and failures without recording private content.
- Internal readiness scores prevent incomplete products, broken paid actions, missing SEO, mobile regressions, or inaccessible interfaces from silently shipping.
- Product screenshots and visual regression artifacts regenerate automatically.
- Wallet health exposes purchased, reserved, committed, released, expired, unused, and anomalous balances.
- Games gain non-pay-to-win progression, cosmetics, replays, achievements, accessibility profiles, and cross-game identity.
- Creator tools gain templates, workflows, project continuity, autosave, recovery, asset shelves, and optional collaboration.
- Developer products gain API capacity, sandbox currency, usage budgets, logs, diagnostics, and deterministic billing testimony.
- Future creator/enterprise revenue layers sit on top of proven identity, settlement, moderation, support, and reconciliation instead of preceding them.
